questions.question: Which timezone should count as our local time for the month?

options.label: Server timezone
options.adds: Use the server's system timezone as local time before taking the month.

options.label: Specific IANA zone
options.adds: Use the IANA timezone I give you as local time before taking the month.

options.label: Keep UTC
options.adds: Take the month from the UTC value without converting to local time.
